pages.text: A jar holds 100 kFE, full from the chair. As the jar you spend 2 FE/t: about 40 min. In your body, nothing.$(br)At 0 powered modules stop; Armour Plating, Drill Bit, Magnet, Self-Righting Gyro and Night Lens still work.
To recharge:$(li)feed slot: redstone, 5 kFE a dust, 45 a block$(li)Charging Dock: stand on it, 500 FE/t$(li)a Dock under your placed head$(li)a Cradle holding your head: up to 10 kFE a second
